newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CVRD holders may switch to oil, power shrs - paper.
newsitem.headline: CVRD holders may switch to oil, power shrs - paper.

text.p: Shareholders of Brazil's Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) will be allowed to exchange their common stocks for shares in Petrobras and Eletrobras after the firm's privatization auction on April 29 to discourage minority shareholders, particularly the pension funds, from selling their stakes, Jornal do Brasil daily said.
Vale's privatization will start with the sale of a 45 percent voting stake. The auction will only be valid if the government sells a minimum 40 percent, the daily said.
Minority shareholders are also allowed to offer their stakes at the sale, which means that if they offer more than five percent, the auction would not be valid, it added.
Jornal do Brasil said the new rules would be published by next week by Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES).
